entities.name: Ayesh
entities.description: Last survivor of Oneah who tells its stories and trains goblins in Mirtiin.

entities.name: Oneah
entities.description: Land whose cities were destroyed by a goblin invasion.

entities.name: Myrrax
entities.description: Minotaur king of Mirtiin who drugs and trains goblins.

entities.name: Scaraya
entities.description: Minotaur clan leader who helps train goblins.

entities.name: Betalem
entities.description: Priest from Stahaan who sees the goblins and Ayesh as taboo.

entities.name: Tlik
entities.description: Ayesh's star pupil, the one surviving goblin.

entities.name: Mirtiin
entities.description: Minotaur kingdom where goblins are trained.

entities.name: Stahaan
entities.description: Neighboring minotaur kingdom that invades Mirtiin.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Goblins who destroyed Oneah and are trained by Ayesh.

events.summary: Ayesh gets drunk, picks a fight with goblins, and is saved by minotaurs from Mirtiin.
events.quote: she is saved by some minotaurs from Mirtiin

events.summary: Ayesh learns Myrrax and Scaraya are drugging goblins to train them fearless, and agrees to help.
events.quote: are drugging goblins and training them to overcome fear

events.summary: Civil war and a Stahaan invasion cause the trained goblins to revert and be killed, except Tlik.
events.quote: This proves too much for the goblins, who revert to their wild ways and are killed.

events.summary: Ayesh and Tlik flee; Ayesh is poisoned and Tlik saves her, realizing he belongs to neither goblins nor humans.
events.quote: Ayesh gets poisoned and Tlik saves her.

relations.note: Her star pupil who saves her.
